Trail Technology · Unit 7: Electricity · Module 5

Circuits and DC Instruments

Series and parallel circuits, voltage drops, internal resistance, meters and capacitors in circuits.

Lesson coming

The question

If you wire two lights to one battery, does it matter how?

The physics

  • Series circuits
  • Parallel circuits
  • Voltage drop
  • Ammeters and voltmeters
  • Internal resistance
  • Circuit analysis
  • Capacitors in circuits

The math

  • series: R = R₁ + R₂ + …
  • parallel: 1/R = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + …
  • terminal voltage = emf − Ir

Learning objectives

  • Analyze a series circuit
  • Analyze a parallel circuit
  • Explain a battery’s internal resistance and terminal voltage
  • Describe how to measure current and voltage
  • Describe how a capacitor charges and discharges in a circuit

Helps to know first: Current, Resistance and Ohm’s Law.

The mountain biking connection

Lighting circuits, battery management systems, sensors and electronic shifting are all circuits. Series and parallel wiring behave very differently.

Learning activities

Learning activities for this topic are being developed.
